offering_description.value: Sells property, casualty, and employee benefits insurance placed with carriers to businesses and individuals through brokerage, wholesale, and program administration; earns commissions and service fees from clients and insurance carriers.

primary_services.value: insurance brokerage; wholesale brokerage; program administration; risk management consulting; claims advocacy

customer_segment.value: B2B: commercial clients, including businesses, nonprofits and public-entity-adjacent organizations; B2C: individuals and families buying personal lines insurance

end_markets.value: construction; real estate; hospitality; healthcare; manufacturing; personal insurance

revenue_model.value: commissions or management fees: commissions from insurance carriers on policies placed, and program management fees; service fees: fees for risk consulting, claims advocacy and administration
revenue_model.category: commissions or management fees; service fees

value_chain_position.value: financial intermediary: places insurance coverage, taking commissions from carriers and selling to businesses and individuals; service provider: provides risk consulting, claims handling and program administration to clients and agencies

geography_served.value: US national: offices and clients across many US states

specialization.value: related lines: retail and wholesale insurance brokerage, program administration, and personal lines, sharing carrier relationships and expertise

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: producers selling insurance to commercial and personal clients; own locations: branch offices across the US; partners / resellers: independent agencies served through wholesale and program arrangements
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; own locations; partners / resellers

regulatory_exposure.value: high: insurance producer licensing and carrier appointments under state insurance departments, plus federal and state insurance rules

notes: Ownership and operations may have changed following Brown & Brown's announced acquisition of Baldwin; description reflects my knowledge.
